note: The Chinese deep-forest grounds the story miner works (principal 2026-09-04): competition records, trader interviews, quant-platform communities, Q&A/blog/social, code hosts, video, forums. Every ground carries a ROUTE (how it is reached from a datacenter box), and every run re-measures reachability rather than trusting this file. Concepts are reimplemented; nothing is copied. Crypto-exchange grounds are forbidden and fenced in code (libs.research.mechanism_claims.FORBIDDEN_VENUES). Sibling forests (JP/KR/RU) ride the same routes and grammar.
